name: Kachalu Protein Chaat
ingredients: Lemon, roasted jeera, amchur and coriander
steps: Boil kachalu until tender and cool.
Add kala chana, cucumber and tomato.
Season with lemon, jeera and amchur; mix gently.
note: Taro is starchy; keep the portion moderate and combine with chana.
